mapper.sql: D.UDP_ID as "udpId", D.TARGET_TP as "targetTp", D.UDP_NM as "udpNm", D.DATA_TP as "dataTp", array_to_string(D.SELECT_VALS, chr(10)) as "selectVals", D.REQUIRED_YN as "requiredYn", D.SORT_ORDER as "sortOrder", D.USE_YN as "useYn", D.DFLT_SET_YN as "dfltSetYn", D.UDP_DESC as "udpDesc", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_UDP_VAL V WHERE V.UDP_ID = D.UDP_ID) as "valCnt"
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TB_UDP_DEF D WHERE 1 = 1 AND D.TARGET_TP = #{targetTp} AND COALESCE(D.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' ORDER BY CASE D.TARGET_TP WHEN 'OBJ' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, D.SORT_ORDER, D.UDP_NM
SELECT FROM TB_UDP_DEF D WHERE D.UDP_ID = #{value}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_UDP_DEF WHERE TARGET_TP = #{targetTp} AND UDP_NM = #{udpNm} AND UDP_ID <> COALESCE(#{udpId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_UDP_DEF (UDP_ID, TARGET_TP, UDP_NM, DATA_TP, SELECT_VALS, REQUIRED_YN, SORT_ORDER, USE_YN, DFLT_SET_YN, UDP_DESC, CRET_DT, CRET_USER_ID) VALUES (#{udpId}, #{targetTp}, #{udpNm}, #{dataTp}, ARRAY[#{v}]::text[]NULL, #{requiredYn}, #{sortOrder}, 'Y', 'N', #{udpDesc, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, to_char(now(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), #{userId})
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_UDP_DEF SET UDP_NM = #{udpNm}, DATA_TP = #{dataTp}, SELECT_VALS = ARRAY[#{v}]::text[]NULL, REQUIRED_YN = #{requiredYn}, SORT_ORDER = #{sortOrder}, USE_YN = #{useYn}, UDP_DESC = #{udpDesc, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDT_DT = to_char(now(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), UPDT_USER_ID = #{userId} WHERE UDP_ID = #{udpId}
mapper.select: SELECT V.UDP_ID as "udpId", V.VAL as "val" FROM TB_UDP_VAL V WHERE V.DM_ID = #{dmId} AND V.OBJ_OWNER = #{objOwner} AND V.OBJ_NM = #{objNm} AND V.ATTR_NM = ''

SELECT V.OBJ_OWNER as "objOwner", V.OBJ_NM as "objNm", string_agg(D.UDP_NM || ': ' || V.VAL, ' · ' ORDER BY D.SORT_ORDER, D.UDP_NM) as "summary" FROM TB_UDP_VAL V JOIN TB_UDP_DEF D ON D.UDP_ID = V.UDP_ID AND COALESCE(D.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' WHERE V.DM_ID = #{value} AND V.ATTR_NM = '' AND V.VAL IS NOT NULL AND V.VAL <> '' GROUP BY V.OBJ_OWNER, V.OBJ_NM
SELECT V.OBJ_OWNER as "objOwner", V.OBJ_NM as "objNm", V.UDP_ID as "udpId", V.VAL as "val" FROM TB_UDP_VAL V WHERE V.DM_ID = #{value} AND V.ATTR_NM = ''
SELECT V.ATTR_NM as "attrNm", V.UDP_ID as "udpId", V.VAL as "val" FROM TB_UDP_VAL V WHERE V.DM_ID = #{dmId} AND V.OBJ_OWNER = #{objOwner} AND V.OBJ_NM = #{objNm} AND V.ATTR_NM <> ''

SELECT V.OBJ_OWNER as "objOwner", V.OBJ_NM as "objNm", V.ATTR_NM as "attrNm", V.UDP_ID as "udpId", V.VAL as "val", A.APRV_STATUS as "aprvStatus", A.REQUESTER_USER_ID as "requesterUserId" FROM TB_UDP_VAL V JOIN TB_DATA_MODEL_ATTR A ON A.DM_ID = V.DM_ID AND A.OBJ_OWNER = V.OBJ_OWNER AND A.OBJ_NM = V.OBJ_NM AND A.ATTR_NM = V.ATTR_NM AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE V.DM_ID = #{value}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_UDP_VAL (UDP_ID, DM_ID, OBJ_OWNER, OBJ_NM, ATTR_NM, VAL, UPDT_DT, UPDT_USER_ID) VALUES (#{udpId}, #{dmId}, #{objOwner}, #{objNm}, #{attrNm}, #{val}, to_char(now(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), #{userId}) ON CONFLICT (UDP_ID, DM_ID, OBJ_OWNER, OBJ_NM, ATTR_NM) DO UPDATE SET VAL = EXCLUDED.VAL, UPDT_DT = EXCLUDED.UPDT_DT, UPDT_USER_ID = EXCLUDED.UPDT_USER_ID
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_UDP_VAL WHERE UDP_ID = #{udpId} AND DM_ID = #{dmId} AND OBJ_OWNER = #{objOwner} AND OBJ_NM = #{objNm} AND ATTR_NM = #{attrNm}
DELETE FROM TB_UDP_VAL WHERE DM_ID = #{dataModelId} AND OBJ_OWNER = COALESCE(#{objOwner, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '') AND OBJ_NM = #{objNm} AND ATTR_NM = #{attrNm}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_UDP_VAL SET ATTR_NM = #{newAttrNm} WHERE DM_ID = #{dataModelId} AND OBJ_OWNER = COALESCE(#{objOwner, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '') AND OBJ_NM = #{objNm} AND ATTR_NM = #{origAttrNm}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_UDP_VAL T WHERE T.DM_ID = #{dataModelId} AND T.OBJ_OWNER = #{toOwner} AND T.OBJ_NM = #{toObjNm} AND T.ATTR_NM = #{toAttrNm} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_UDP_VAL S WHERE S.UDP_ID = T.UDP_ID AND S.DM_ID = T.DM_ID AND S.OBJ_OWNER = #{fromOwner} AND S.OBJ_NM = #{fromObjNm} AND S.ATTR_NM = #{fromAttrNm})
DELETE FROM TB_UDP_VAL WHERE DM_ID = #{dataModelId} AND OBJ_OWNER = #{objOwner} AND OBJ_NM = #{objNm}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_UDP_VAL SET OBJ_OWNER = #{newOwner}, OBJ_NM = #{newObjNm} WHERE DM_ID = #{dmId} AND OBJ_OWNER = #{origOwner} AND OBJ_NM = #{origObjNm}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_UDP_VAL T WHERE T.DM_ID = #{dataModelId} AND T.OBJ_OWNER = #{toOwner} AND T.OBJ_NM = #{toObjNm} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_UDP_VAL S WHERE S.UDP_ID = T.UDP_ID AND S.DM_ID = T.DM_ID AND S.ATTR_NM = T.ATTR_NM AND S.OBJ_OWNER = #{fromOwner} AND S.OBJ_NM = #{fromObjNm})
